usedFor: Shopify sends the store events and Decision Maker judges them. A “New Customer” or “Order Cancelled” in Shopify can feed “Decision Maker”, which answers a yes/no, choice or score question and returns a confidence value.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Decision Maker” in Decision Maker
bestTemplate.why: A cancellation is a moment that needs a call. “Decision Maker” turns the order into a decision with a confidence value you can route on, for example sorting refunds from mistakes.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so it reaches Decision Maker on a schedule. “Decision Maker” only returns a decision and a confidence value; whatever should happen next is a separate step you add.
